title: Klunk syllabus model
description: A course's outcomes and content points, in a shape questions can reference. Klunk ships no syllabus models: a syllabus document is usually licensed, so each teacher generates a model from their own copy into their own folder. See tools/ for generators.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'nsw-hsc-design-technology'. Papers and banks record this, so renaming it orphans them.

framework.description: Curriculum authority's framework, e.g. 'NESA' or 'IB'. Deliberately a free string, not an enum: a faculty should be able to add a framework without waiting for a release of Klunk.

authority.description: Who publishes the syllabus, spelled out for attribution on generated papers.

syllabusVersion.description: Which edition this models, e.g. 'Stage 6 (2013)'. Syllabuses are reissued, and a bank tagged against one edition may not map to the next.

source.description: Provenance for the document this was generated from. Recorded so a teacher can tell whether their model is current, and so attribution can be printed.

licence.description: Copy the source's own terms here. Klunk reads this and refuses to bundle a model whose licence forbids redistribution.

redistributable.description: False unless the source licence clearly permits republication. Defaults to false when absent, which is the safe reading.

courses.description: A syllabus may cover more than one course, e.g. Preliminary and HSC, or SL and HL.

outcomes.description: Every outcome for the course. Topics name the subset that applies; the text lives here once and is never restated.

topics.description: The course content in published order, IN FULL. Topics no exam covers must still appear, or a coverage report can never surface the gap.

id.description: Locally assigned and stable, e.g. 'PRE-04'. Not an official code, because most syllabuses do not number their content. Never renumber once questions reference it.

name.description: Tidied for display and filtering, e.g. trailing 'including:' removed.

text.description: The heading verbatim from the syllabus, kept because 'name' is edited and the original still has to be checkable.

outcomes.description: Outcome codes this topic serves. Most syllabuses map outcomes to a block of content rather than to each point, so this sits at topic level.

points.description: The content points. May be empty when the topic heading is itself the only content point, in which case questions reference the topic id.

skills.description: The 'students learn to' side, where the syllabus separates knowledge from skill. Not referenced by questions; carried so the model is complete.

id.description: Topic id plus an ordinal, e.g. 'PRE-04.03'. This is what a question tags itself with.

ownedBy.description: Set when this point is deliberately assessed elsewhere. Suppresses the uncovered flag and records the decision instead of leaving it in someone's head.
